unit: one model token per independent generation sequence
compatibility: same live model instance and validated graph/tokenizer/storage identity
same cache precision and native CPU kernel contract
same execution settings including worker count and configured prefill chunk ceiling
request_private: KV, causal attention, scratch and token ledger
selected prompt, history, penalties, sampling options and RNG
grammar, token mask, stop state, tool parser and output
cancellation, deadline, usage, reservations and prefix cache ownership
shared: immutable model weights; each matrix tile read once per compatible scheduling unit
fairness: oldest pending model group; bounded compatible packing; FIFO compute semaphore shared with embedding microbatches; output delivery outside shared compute
memory: reuse admitted per-sequence workspaces, loan one lane's I/O/decode tile without a batch-sized input/output matrix or full-weight copy; reservation ownership moves with state
failure: lane cancellation and numerical/constraint/output failures retire that lane; shared weight storage failures invalidate affected model participants
placement: CPU only; no automatic backend/model fallback
unqualified: sustained security, fairness/tail-latency and release soak campaigns
